summary: The strict story check now fails when a story has no accessibility evidence, and keeps checking stories after in-app navigation.

replay.detail: No replay or backfill. This changes only the UI story check.

rules.detail: No checkpoint or fleet coordination changes.

compatibility.detail: The strict story check now requires one completed story and one passed accessibility report per case when accessibility checks are on. In-app navigation keeps collecting evidence; navigation to a replacement document fails the check. Stories that previously passed without evidence now fail. Client and wire formats are unchanged.

downtime.detail: No service interruption; only the development and CI story check changes.

manual.detail: No configuration or manual upgrade steps.

recovery.detail: No data migration to undo. Reverting restores the previous story check, including its missing-evidence gap.
